descriptions.w3d_d40j_material_set_clear_80171624: Material set reset: clears flag 0x8000; for each key looks up the owner, finds the selected part in its array field at +44 and removes it through 0x801ef380; clears the compact arrays at +52 and +64, frees every entry's storage, empties the key array and releases the shared interface. Returns 0. Names are inferred.
